changelog: Impersonation banner (#3876): the return button works on a second impersonation in the same tab — the app-wide banner kept its `busy` state across sessions, so the button stayed disabled. When the 30-minute cap reverts the session, the banner now switches at the deadline (a session `update()` at `impersonationExpiresAt`) and says the view ended, instead of vanishing without a word; the session exposes `impersonationExpiresAt` / `impersonationEndedAt` for it.

en: Viewing as another user: "Return to your account" works every time, and when the 30-minute limit ends the view, a notice says so.
tr: Başka kullanıcı olarak görüntüleme: "Kendi hesabına dön" her seferinde çalışıyor; 30 dakikalık süre dolunca bir uyarı bunu bildiriyor.
de: Ansicht als anderer Nutzer: „Zu deinem Konto zurückkehren“ funktioniert jedes Mal, und nach Ablauf der 30 Minuten weist ein Hinweis darauf hin.
